The Safe Prescribing Through Reporting Act sounds noble—until you realize it’s another layer of bureaucracy forcing doctors to feed data into bloated federal systems. H.R. 3595’s mandate to share substance use disorder records with state PDMPs risks patient privacy while doing nothing to address Big Pharma’s stranglehold on drug pricing.

Meanwhile, the Right Drug Dose Now Act of 2025 (H.R. 2471) wastes $10M+ updating EHRs for pharmacogenomic alerts that’ll be ignored by overworked providers. Real solutions? Slash FDA red tape strangling drug competition and audit Medicare’s $47B in annual improper payments fueling this mess.
